the PPP was stimulated in fenogreek sprouts through pentose phosphate and the shikimate pathway by natural elicitors.

The main takeaway from our work is that
natural elicitors such Lactoferrins, Oregano extract and Fish Protein Hydrolysate are effective in increasing the antioxidant activity and antimicrobial function of sprouted fenugreek.

elicitation of fenugreek sprouting seeds by FPH, LF and OE can be used to enhance their phenolic, antioxidant, antimicrobial and nutritional properties, and can be used as an alternative to the use of synthetic elicitors.
